notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist and Archaeomancer, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Agadeem's Awakening by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, returning Archaeomancer and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Dockside Extortionist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Agadeem's Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
